lines.trans: Do not let yourself be fooled, Fabrice!
This woman is very dangerous.
Excuse me? What are you talking about?
The Bond film story was total nonsense!
It is Andréa who engineered everything.
I do not have the power to make that up.
It was not the real casting director.
Well then, who was this woman?
She wanted to get revenge on our agency.
It is you who called the tax inspectors!
Your agency is completely ruined!
Believe what you want, Fabrice.
You agents are really strange!
Leave me alone, François!

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency
artistic agent who finds work for actors

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Elle me veut pour le casting!
examples.trans: She wants me for the casting!

meanings.en: casting, audition process (for a film or play)

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu as complètement perdu la tête!

meanings.en: to make up a story, invent

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: to plot, scheme behind someone's back

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: tranquility, peace (laisser en paix = leave alone)
pardon? = what did you say? / excuse me?
pas du tout: not at all

je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

before the verb; t' before a vowel

plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
